story.value: The name rhenium comes from the Latin word rhenus, for the Rhine river in Germany.
Rhenium was discovered in 1925 by German chemists Walter Noddack, Ida Tacke and Otto Berg, using x-ray spectroscopy.

uses.value: Rhenium is used in flash lamps for photography.
Rhenium is used for filaments in mass spectrographs and ion gauges.
Rhenium is used as a material for electrical contacts.
